{{Quote|Why is Tracer itching for a fight anyway?''"<br />"''He's a tailgun. He never sees what we're flying into, only what we're flying away from.|Warthog and a clone pilot|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
'''Tracer''' was the adopted name of a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]] [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Hunter [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] was assigned to destroy the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]] [[Gwori shipyards|shipyards]] at [[Gwori]]. After a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was smuggled to Gwori in order to obtain the exact coordinates of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] briefed Hunter Squadron on the upcoming mission.

After successfully passing the enemy [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]], Tiin ordered Tracer and Hunter Squadron to [[Battle of Gwori|destroy]] the shipyards. However, the squadron's bombs were insufficient to destroy all of the enemy [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] in the shipyards, and Koon ordered them to target the construction supports instead. En route, the Y-wing [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] were attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], and Tracer, serving as [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] on fellow [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]], managed to destroy several [[Droid/Legends|droids]] but was hit by a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] bolt in the chest. The squadron proceeded to destroy the shipyards and, after the destruction, jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and retreated from their victory at Gwori. However, Tracer [[Death/Legends|died]] from his wound shortly before the jump.

==Biography==
===Preparation for the attack of Gwori===
{{Quote|So we got another no returner mission. How is it we're on the list for all the tough jobs?''"<br />"''Cause we never miss, Warthog. I'll bet you drinks for ten rotations we come out of this without a scratch.|Warthog and Tracer, before the briefing|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
[[File:Warthog.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Warthog, Tracer's pilot and friend]]
Tracer was the name taken by<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]]<ref name="SWE" /> from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="clone troopers" /> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="SWE" /> to fight for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="clone troopers" /> A [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]], Tracer was part of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Hunter Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Hunter Squadron]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] and was assigned to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> the Republic suffered a series of major defeats in [[Space warfare/Legends|space battles]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], largely due to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] having four times as many [[Starship/Legends|ships]] as the Republic [[Navy/Legends|Navy]]. To combat this, the Republic decided to smuggle a team of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]] [[Gwori shipyards|shipyards]] at [[Gwori]] in order to obtain the exact coordinates of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] and conduct an assault.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

After the team successfully landed, they captured a Separatist [[Comm unit/Legends|comm]] tower. From the tower, Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] reported the coordinates to the Republic task force under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Koon and [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] in the [[Moskk system/Legends|Moskk system]], where Hunter [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] had been stationed. While Tracer and fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Warthog/Legends|Warthog]] made a bet about the outcome of the mission, Koon and Tiin began to brief Hunter Squadron about the upcoming attack aboard a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]], informing them that the shipyards were in a system of canyons on the planet and that they would have to destroy them with the [[Proton cannon/Legends|proton cannons]] on their Y-wing [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

At the behest of a [[Unidentified clone trooper pilot (Hunter Squadron)|pilot]], Tiin revealed that they would be making an exact [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump between the Separatist [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of Gwori and the planet itself, and Koon further explained that the risk of the jump was worth it, because it would save the lives of countless clones and millions of beings. After the briefing, Warthog asked Tracer to rethink his bet. Shortly after, Hunter Squadron in their Y-wings, along with the Jedi Masters in their [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighters]], prepared to jump, and Koon ordered them to make sure their [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputers]] were all synchronized, since if they were slightly off, they would come out before the blockade or inside the planet. Once all was ready, Tracer, serving as the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] of Warthog's bomber, and Hunter Squadron jumped to hyperspace.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

===Attack on Gwori===
{{Quote|I hope you got a lot of credits with the brewers on Coruscant, Warthog!''"<br />"''We live through this and I buy you all the drinks you want, Tracer!|Tracer and Warthog, upon coming out of hyperspace|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
After successfully exiting hyperspace between the blockade and Gwori, Koon contacted the squadron and ordered them to focus on their objective. Approaching the canyons of Gwori, Tiin and Koon destroyed the [[Anti-aircraft gun|anti-air turrets]] on the ground. Tracer and the squadron then [[Battle of Gwori|bombed]] the shipyards, destroying numerous [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], though many more remained intact due to the squadron's lack of appropriate ammunition. Koon then ordered the squadron to assume [[Bantha formation/Legends|Bantha formation]] and target the construction supports.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

On the way there, the squadron was attacked by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]], which Tracer opened fire on. Although he managed to destroy several [[Droid/Legends|droids]], he was soon hit by a [[Laser/Legends|laser]] bolt in the chest. The squadron proceeded to bomb and destroy the construction supports, resulting in the destruction of the shipyards. Warthog informed the injured Tracer of the success, but Tracer responded that he would let him out of their bet and [[Death/Legends|died]] shortly afterward. Hunter Squadron then jumped to hyperspace with their mission completed.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You want go double or nothing by that bet, Warthog?''"<br />"''Tracer, if we hit the planet, you're gonna die too.''"<br />"''Yes, but not before you! Ha ha!|Tracer and Warthog, before jumping to hyperspace|<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />}}
Tracer was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] clone with [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and tan skin.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> Like all clones of Jango Fett,<ref name="clone troopers" /> Tracer stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="SWE" /> As a clone pilot, Tracer was raised to be loyal to the Republic and his Jedi [[Commander/Legends|commanders]]. He was a good friend of fellow pilot Warthog and bet with him about the outcome of their mission to Gwori. Tracer was a skilled gunner, managing to shoot down several Vulture [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] during the attack on Gwori. He was also a very confident clone, and even on the very dangerous mission to Gwori Tracer believed that he and Warthog would survive it "without a scratch." However, while Warthog survived the battle, Tracer did not.<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

==Equipment==
During the assault on the Gwori shipyards, Tracer wore the pilot version of the white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tracer first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|graphic novella]] ''[[The Clone Wars: Shipyards of Doom]]'', which was published by [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse]]<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" /> on [[September 24]], [[2009]]<ref name="DH-Link">{{DarkHorse|url=Books/15-686/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars--Shipyards-of-Doom|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars--Shipyards of Doom}}</ref> and written by [[Henry Gilroy]]. The character was illustrated by the [[Fillbach Brothers]].<ref name="Shipyards of Doom" />
